payload.title: Discover source items through RSS and Atom Monitors
payload.description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a editor, I want feed Monitors that retain source identity and revisions, so that I can evaluate new and changed source material.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Discover source items through RSS and Atom Monitors
  Scenario: Repeat feed intake
    Given an RSS or Atom Monitor with previously observed source entries
    When a bounded collection run sees existing, new and updated entries
    Then unchanged entries do not create duplicate canonical references
    And new entries and meaningful updates are recorded for evaluation
    And source URL, source entry identity, Monitor identity and observation time remain attributable
    And failures or incomplete runs are visible without claiming unseen content was processed
```

Incoming source subscriptions are distinct from Papyrus outgoing publication feeds. Access rights and source-specific refresh limits require validation.
